comment: Dr. Merritt is incredibly kind, insightful, and flexible. Her enthusiasm is contagious! Her lectures had everyone in our Putin class hooked on Russian politics. Her lectures can be emotional, hilarious, and shocking in the best possible way. She's also super accessible outside class even as the Dean of International Education. 10/10 recommend

I had this class at 7:30 am, but Dr. Merritt kept me enticed the entire time. I was never bored in this class and the material was interesting. She wants you to do well and she wants you to learn. There is a good bit of reading, but I thought it was manageable. Overall, I had a great experience and I would certainly recommend it.
